mechanism: Detect swing XABCD via lookback IsSwingHigh/IsSwingLow; re-anchor each leg to ArrayMinimum/Maximum extreme between consecutive pivots; require B in [61.8%,78.6%] Fibonacci retracement of XA and bullish D < X (bearish D > X); only then emit completion / entry at D+(LookbackBars/2) with SL at D and TP at C.
data_needed: OHLC arrays; LookbackBars; bars_check; Fib levels lvl_61_8/lvl_78_6 from validated XA; Bars/ArrayMinimum/ArrayMaximum per leg.
why_new_for_mis: Harmonic completion sensor gated by a tight Fib band on B plus D-beyond-X, after dominant-extreme cleanup—MIS can flag PRZ-style reversal completions without buffer-based oscillators.
quote: B must be inside the 61.8% to 78.6% retracement of XA… point D must be below point X

mechanism: After provisional swing picks, for each leg (XA, AB, BC, CD) count Bars between endpoints and replace the provisional pivot with ArrayMinimum (lows) or ArrayMaximum (highs) inside that segment so X/A/B/C are true segment extremes before Fib or geometry checks.
data_needed: High/low/time arrays; segment bar counts; ArrayMinimum/ArrayMaximum indices and prices.
why_new_for_mis: Sensing hygiene that upgrades first-touch swings to path-dominant extrema—MIS pattern legs stay structurally honest under noisy secondary swings.
quote: X should likewise be the highest high between A and B… B ought to be the lowest low between B and C

mechanism: Label swing L→H→HL→HH (bull) or H→L→LH→LL (bear); confirm L<H, HL∈(L,H), HH>H (mirror for bear); treat that sequence as active bullish/bearish structure regime until invalidated.
data_needed: Swing highs/lows with LookbackBars; nested forward scans; structure inequalities.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit discrete market-structure state (HH/HL vs LH/LL) as a regime label MIS can consume before entries, not just a trade signal.
quote: A low, a high, a higher low, and a higher high are the main price points that must be identified to accomplish this. This pattern denotes a bullish trend

mechanism: Box HL→HH (or LH→LL); lvl_50 = HL + (HH−HL)/2 splits discount (below) vs premium (above); strategy only arms buys on break/close above HH (premium breakout), SL at lvl_50, TP1/TP2 at 1:1 and 1:2 from entry−SL.
data_needed: Validated HL/HH prices and times; rectangle and mid-line objects; close vs HH.
why_new_for_mis: Structure-anchored premium/discount mid as a location regime—MIS senses whether price is in cheap/expensive half of the last impulse swing.
quote: Below the 50% mark, the discount zone… The premium zone… is above the 50% mark… we are only interested in buying when the market trades above the premium zone or breaks the Higher High

mechanism: On bullish close>HH (bearish close<LL) after structure, compute n_bars = Bars(HL→box_end) and n_bars_2 = Bars(box_end→break_candle); accept BOS only if n_bars_2 < n_bars and open at box_end still ≤HH (bearish mirror ≥LL)—rejects late/far breakouts.
data_needed: HL/HH times; time[l+LookbackBars]; break candle time; Bars counts; open at box end.
why_new_for_mis: Temporal proximity gate on break-of-structure—MIS change events stay tethered to the forming premium/discount box rather than distant chase breaks.
quote: n_bars_2 < n_bars… the bullish breakout candle… shows up fairly close to the pattern

mechanism: Hidden ray trendlines Wave1–3 and Wave2–4; scan for bullish close that opens below then closes above TL1-3 (≥4 bars after Wave4), then later bearish open-above/close-below same TL; Wave5 = ArrayMaximum high between those crosses; entry on second cross (sell bearish / buy bullish mirror).
data_needed: ObjectGetValueByTime on TL1-3/TL2-4; OHLC; ArrayMaximum between cross bars; Fibonacci 3–4 expansion window for Wave5.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol; input timeframe PERIOD_CURRENT; swing lookback 7; bars_check 500.
why_new_for_mis: Two-step pierce-and-reject of the Wolfe channel rail as a confirmation change sensor—MIS gets a geometric trigger distinct from single-bar BOS.
quote: the candle has to cross above this trend line first… and then cross below it again. This second move… confirms that the market might start to reverse

mechanism: Validate Waves1–4 with dominant extrema; require |W3−W4| ≥ |W1−W2| (and W4 between W2 and W3); W3 inside 127.2–161.8% expansion of W1–W2; W5 high inside 127.2–161.8% (configurable) expansion of W3–W4; exit toward Wave1–4 EPA line or bar-budget timeout.
data_needed: Swing highs/lows; MathAbs leg sizes; Fib expansion levels; Bars between waves; TL1-4 value.
why_new_for_mis: Joint symmetry-plus-expansion geometry sensor for five-wave exhaustion—MIS can score Wolfe-like channel completions with tunable Fib bands.
quote: Waves 3–4 should ideally be at least 70% as long as waves 1–2… Wave 3… inside the 127.2% to 161.8% Fibonacci expansion

mechanism: After validated 0-X-A-B-C with dominant extrema, accept D as swing low (bull) in 50–55% retracement of BC (fib_ret_d_50/55); treat that band as reversal completion zone and buy when price is at/through D with SL at D and TP ≈ 3× risk.
data_needed: Validated B/C extremes; d_bc_min=50, d_bc_max=55; D swing; ask and bar-time dedupe.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol; input timeframe PERIOD_CURRENT; bars_check 400; swing z=4.
why_new_for_mis: Narrow 50–55% BC pocket as a harmonic completion sensor—MIS gets a specific PRZ band for 5-0-style continuation-to-reversal flips.
quote: Point D must develop between the 50% and 55% Fibonacci retracement of the BC leg… often denotes the region where traders expect a possible bullish reversal

mechanism: Bullish 5-0: 0 swing high > X low; A lower high below 0 (no fixed Fib); B in 113–161.8% XA extension; C in 161.8–224% AB extension; then D on BC—chain of extension rectangles as geometric validity sensors before trade.
data_needed: Swing sequence 0,X,A,B,C; b_xa_min/max; c_ab_min/max; extension price formulas; optional dominant-extreme recalc.
why_new_for_mis: Multi-leg extension-ratio chain (not classic Gartley retracement stack) as a pattern-validity sensor—MIS can detect 5-0 geometry distinct from XABCD Gartley-like rules.
quote: point B… between the XA leg's 113% and 161.8% Fibonacci extension… point C… 161.8% and 224% of the AB leg

mechanism: User-named up/down OBJ_TREND rays; sample ObjectGetValueByTime at last 5 closed bars; reversal mode: touch from below (down TL) + bearish close back under line (mirror on up TL); breakout-retest: close through line, retest touch, then confirming candle with opposite polarity; modes reversal / break_out / reverse_break; one trade per bar; SL at confirming candle extreme, TP 1:4.
data_needed: Named trendline objects; OHLC of bars 0–3; ObjectGetValueByTime; bars-since-last-touch counters; line_exe enum.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol; input time_frame PERIOD_CURRENT; last 5 candles.
why_new_for_mis: Dual interaction vocabulary (reject vs break-retest) on the same geometric rail—MIS can sense which regime of line interaction is active.
quote: reversal, where the EA opens a trade when the price touches the trend line and displays a reversal signal… Breakout and Retest mode waits for the price to break through the trend line

mechanism: For each of the last few bar times, read TL price via ObjectGetValueByTime and compare to high/low/open/close to classify pierce, open-side, and close-side relative to the line—continuous geometric distance/cross state without indicator buffers.
data_needed: Chart object names; CopyTime/OHLC series arrays; ObjectGetValueByTime per bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/timeframe of the chart holding the named trendlines.
why_new_for_mis: Object-anchored price-to-line state vector as a sensing primitive—MIS can fuse discretionary geometry with automated cross/reject features.
quote: this function checks where the trend line was at the exact instant each candle appeared… whether the candle touched or crossed the trend line

mechanism: Because indicators cannot WebRequest, read API-saved CSV (e.g. BTCUSDTM30_MQL5.csv) column-stride into Open/High/Low/Close/Time arrays, map last N bars into DRAW_COLOR_CANDLES buffers, and autoscale INDICATOR_MAXIMUM/MINIMUM from ArrayMaximum/Minimum—external venue OHLC becomes a chart sensor when the companion EA refreshes the file.
data_needed: Shared CSV path; FILE_READ|FILE_CSV|FILE_ANSI; fixed column stride; OHLC double arrays; color index buffer.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSDT M30 candles from external API file (10-bar demo window).
why_new_for_mis: File-mediated alternate-exchange candle feed as a sensing channel—MIS can compare or fuse non-broker OHLC without putting WebRequest inside the indicator.
quote: Indicators can only get external candle data by reading it from a file because they are unable to use the WebRequest function directly.

mechanism: Tutorial on packing EA inputs into a simple fixed-size struct and FileWriteStruct/FileReadStruct under FILE_BIN|FILE_COMMON; no market regime, volatility, liquidity, or sequence sensing is built.
why_new_for_mis: Language/persistence tutorial only; after full read, no sensing idea for MIS.
